## Goal
One page, "What's new in Free My ID 0.3", for someone who used 0.2 or is new. Sources (read-only): `docs/marketing/release-notes-v0.3.0.md`, `docs/marketing/release-notes-v0.3.1.md` and the app itself.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Covers only what is in the released 0.3.1 app, each with a citation: the Today screen with one card and "More: safety steps and details" (`src/freemyid/wizard/dashboard.py:275`); the "Is this you?" card with "Yes, this is me" and "No, this is not me" (`dashboard.py:122-123`); "Protect yourself" (`src/freemyid/wizard/ui.py:43`, `views.py:254`); the "Google and Bing" steps (`views.py:228`, `src/freemyid/engine/search_engines.py:33`); "Larger text" (`ui.py:61`); the printable summary, "Print this page" (`views.py:301`); the 0.3.1 "starting" window on first start (cite packaging in words).
- Nothing from the 0.4 plan (`docs/ROADMAP.md` section 6: proof vault, PDF report, Outlook sign-in, tray icon) is described as available.
- A short "How to update" part: run the new installer over the old one. Use the same words as WO-301's `docs/user/INSTALL.md` if it has been delivered (read `.vendor-wt/wo-301/docs/user/INSTALL.md`); otherwise say only what `docs/RELEASE_v0.3.md` line 20 supports (an install over 0.2.0 is an upgrade, not a second app).
- A short "What has not changed" part: practice mode is still on at the start (`dashboard.py:237`), there is no account and nothing to pay (`ui.py:266-267`).
- Fits on one printed page (about 60 lines of Markdown).
- Expected: `tests/copilot/test_cp_user_docs_reachable.py` fails exactly one case, `test_user_page_is_reachable[whats-new-0.3.md]`, because nothing links the new page yet. That is by design: WO-330 links it, and in-house merges this WO and WO-330 together before pushing. Record that one failure in VENDOR_STATUS.md; any other failure is yours to fix.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** text only and offline. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Plain words per `docs/POSITIONING.md`: no "guarantee", "erase", "100%" or "nothing is sent"; say "requested" and "confirmed". A real product bug is a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md (or a strict `xfail` in a test); never edit `src/`. Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first; don't duplicate a guard.

Page rules (new help pages, WO-311..320):
- Quote screen text and button labels exactly as the app shows them, with the source as `src/freemyid/<path>.py:NNN` in an HTML comment on the same line. `tests/copilot/test_cp_source_citations.py` checks that the line exists and that quoted text on that line is in that file. Cite anything that isn't under `src/freemyid/` in words ("brokers/checklists.yaml, line 22"; "packaging/windows/splash_win.py, line 20"), because only `src/freemyid/` files resolve.
- Link only to pages that exist on main today. Don't link to other new pages in this batch: WO-330 adds the help-topics page that links them all.
- First line under the title: who the page is for and what it helps with, in one sentence. Then short sentences (about 15 words), one step per line, numbered steps. No screenshots (none can be made offline). No web addresses except ones the app itself shows; never a GitHub link for regular users.
